sv.title: FN-domstol slår fast: Myanmar begick folkmord
sv.summary: Myanmar begick folkmord mot landets muslimska minoritet rohingyer, slår Internationella domstolen (ICJ) fast.

en.title: UN court rules: Myanmar committed genocide
en.summary: Myanmar committed genocide against the country's Muslim Rohingya minority, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) rules.
